header: The designers who will be on your project
subheadline: No account managers and no hand-off to a delivery team after the pitch. The people below are the ones in the kickoff, in the Thursday critique, and on the call at eight in the morning when something breaks in week nine.

members.name: Tomás Ferreira
members.bio: Sets the direction on every engagement and draws the first version himself. Fifteen years of interface work before the studio, most of it in logistics.

members.name: Sofia Reis
members.bio: Turns four weeks of interview notes into the one problem worth solving, then writes the brief everyone else works against.

members.name: Bruno Salgado
members.bio: Builds the clickable version that goes in front of real users, usually within nine working days of the first sketch.
